test_title: PYST 2: DP Head Constable (AWO/TPO) 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 27 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of persons who like to watch different types of TV channels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a95d5306da1344ded62e5e45d01c7e2a9cc18bb4fcd487962e4bc92556b5274a.png] 

How many persons are there who like to watch both sports and cartoon channels?
solution:
Number of persons who like to watch both sports and cartoon channels = 11 + 9 = 20.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f9d6206f0c5003789e7cffe02d1c5a42bfcdb8a0b9f92502fd85ef581867205.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is " 20 ".
